design.ports: Injected trusted DeliveryPort(identity, account_key, async send, async close); no bundled real sender; default no adapters
design.binding: Driver/account resource key is global across Agent spaces; adapter must verify expected actual sender account before external write, including credential changes
design.intent: Assistant message/run only, exact body SHA and source content epoch, channel configuration revision, adapter identity, account and target, immutable key; unique agent/key
design.output_atomicity: finish and optional intent commit with final message/run/audit. Changed route, full queue or oversized body produce blocked intent without losing generated output. Ordinary chat routing to real accounts waits for R6.
design.approval: Every intent requires explicit owner approval of exact fingerprint, valid 300 seconds; channel edits/disable/archive, source erasure and adapter drift invalidate authority
design.attempts: max 3; only positive not_sent+retryable can retry, delays 2/4 seconds; generic exception/timeout/cancel after dispatch => unknown; no unknown retry or TTL takeover
design.worker: max 4 active, max 64 waiting; account-wide FIFO and unresolved-unknown gate; slot and resource lease held until real port task ends even if cancellation ignored
design.results: Immutable per-attempt observations; late result retained but cannot overwrite interrupted/unknown/cancelled or newer work
design.review: Separate owner evidence/decision bound to exact revision+state+restore epoch, no held transport lease; never edits original unknown outcome or model cost holds
design.reissue: New intent/key and new approval only; unknown parent must be reviewed; sent/ambiguous parent requires explicit duplicate acknowledgement
design.normal_restart: Sending becomes unknown; approved/claimed/retry work has authority revoked and is cancelled as known-unstarted; pending human approval may survive. Explicit new intent and approval required.
design.restore: All unfinished aggregate/attempt state quarantined, approval revoked, review epoch advanced, resources released; existing completion marker preserved
design.schedule: Pending including blocked or held outbound is active and not reviewable; scheduling review pins outcome_revision, not display/CAS revision. Late observations reblock; archive does not.
design.erasure: No duplicate body snapshots. Common context-epoch invalidation cancels unsent outbound, marks sending unknown; dispatch and settlement check source epoch/hash
design.cancel: Delivery has independent cancellation; cancelling a run/occurrence also cancels its outbound even when generation run is already succeeded
design.lifecycle: One shared 30s Instance close deadline; stop admission/workers, revoke approval, drain/cancel Application+Delivery, then documents/objects, then storage/logs; retain lock on residual; direct Application.close defaults retained for tests
design.credentials: PUT/DELETE /api/v1/credentials?reference=... accepts hierarchical references; validate/bound input, revoke prior authority before touching external credential backend.
